about: Capability-gated CLI commands for scripts/cmux-next/skew-matrix.py (plans/cmux-next/version-skew.md step 5). argv follows the global options `--socket <daemon socket> --json`. A case passes when it works, re-execs the daemon's CLI, or prints one exact fix command (cli/fix_command.rs). works_if: error texts that mean the command reached a daemon that serves it (a domain answer, not a skew). stops_daemon: the command ends the daemon, so the runner does not stop it again.

cases.pass: lists producers, or the restart fix command
lists hooks, or the restart fix command
lists checkpoints, or the restart fix command
lists segments, or the restart fix command
the stats, or server.stats_unsupported with the restart fix command
reaches conversation.list (no Chief on an isolated daemon), or the stop fix command
the daemon stops, or a fix command
the daemon stops with its terminals, or a fix command

skipped.commands: session <s> journal subscribe | append | producer put | hook put | checkpoint create | segment seal
skipped.reason: the same wire.rs gate as the journal list cases; subscribe follows forever, and the writes need a producer manifest. The list cases cover the gate.
needs a checkpoint: on an empty journal every build answers operation.failed ("journal operation failed"), not a skew. The list cases cover the same wire.rs gate.
no dead end: without the capability the CLI cancels by closing the connection. Needs an installed app plugin and an interrupt.
